claim_boundary: A digital single-window derivative of proposed C-lite, not the full C0 system, an RF measurement, hardware qualification or heldout transfer result.
mechanism: Energy arrival before and after a query, cold-start readiness, volatile query capture, earliest-TX scheduling and a fixed causal reply deadline; no additional physical relation is supplied.
missing_measurements: RF field and RF-to-DC efficiency or load-response waveform
Measured tag current, PMIC cold-start/UVLO and conversion losses
Real capacitor leakage/ESR and calibrated voltage thresholds
Actual PHY/CRC reliability, clock uncertainty and temperature dependence
qualification_required_before_matrix: S0 freezes/version-binds this new task and its full public facts before any outcome
S0 adapts/qualifies query nonce, freshness and ordered query-to-reply receiver gates; the old event-receive label alone is insufficient
Independently check source integral, complete service and task-specific event order at declared dt; no B preparation solve
Apply identical task/evaluator/source across arms and count every candidate exposure within the group total
scope_changes: First contact window only: 0..30 s from the original [0,0.5] min window
One tag and one gateway instead of the full ten-tag/two-gateway 60 min C0 system
Single deterministic nonce/query; no collisions, packet loss or multi-tag scheduling
DC port power is prescribed; no RF electromagnetic or load-dependent RF conversion claim
selection_reason: C-lite supplies explicit proposed DC power, storage, idle load, query timing and reply deadline. A bounded single-window event task can be executed digitally without inventing measured RF conversion or waiting for hardware.

source.parameter_status: All new numeric service profiles are proposed task requirements, not validated capabilities.

synthetic_ideal_assumptions.note: These values are explicit digital construction choices, not measured/vendor parameters. TX power and duration encode the declared 50 uJ reply cost. No physical boot or RF implementation is qualified.
